data.cultural_impact: The name "Dulu" has a rich and endearing cultural significance in the Hindu tradition. It is often used as a term of endearment among family members and friends for young children. Dulu carries the warmth and love of a mother or a caregiver towards their little one. Additionally, the name is widely used as a piran marble name, a common game played in North India, which adds to the popularity and cultural relevance of the name.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Hindu spiritual context, the name "Dulu" can be seen as a reminder of the divine love and protection that the deities bestow upon us, especially towards the newborns and children. The name carries the purity, innocence, and vulnerability of a child, emphasizing the divine connection between the human being and the divine. "Dulu" can serve as a reminder to cherish and nurture our childhood, and to carry the innocence and purity of our inner child throughout our lives.
